notes: The opening «وعن أبي عبد الله» names no transmitter before the Imam; prev1 to prev3 open the same way, so the links above him are not written in this text and are not taken from them (not a back reference)
The Imam is named after «عن», so he stays narrator (ruling 2); the blessing is left out
«قال رسول الله» introduces the Prophet's saying; he is the end of the chain, not a link
